meta.name: letter_frames
meta.description: The frames of a letter that goes with a printed document (jav/app/letters.py, letter@1): per frame its language, the subject, the greeting with the addressee's name and without one, the paragraphs, the closing and the email file's name. A marker {{key}} is a value of the printed document's output (configs/outputs.json), written by code in the frame's language as the document writes it; an unknown marker is left as it is and the letter cannot be accepted with one. The texts are document vocabulary (the letter a client reads). limits: the subject's and the body's length a person may accept.
